_notes: Starter English copy for every key in the FE guide's Appendix B (adaptive-engine-fe-guide.md).

Keys containing <category> are per-category insight codes: the API sends them with the category lower-cased (e.g. insight.budget_pace.food). Register one template and substitute, or expand per category.

Notification content arrives as key or key|arg (split on the first pipe). {placeholders} below are named after the real insight `metrics` / suggestion `proposedAction` fields (or the pipe arg where noted).
Render numbers exactly as given — never recompute or re-round the figures the API sends.
notification.nudge.* keys (Wave 4) are deep-link calls to action: no suggestion card, no accept step — the deep link (e.g. app://projects/create?amount=...) carries the pre-fill data.
insight.overspend_anomaly.<category>: Unusually high {category} spending this month: {actual} vs your typical {baseline}.
insight.budget_pace.<category>: On this pace, {category} will reach {projectedEndOfMonth} by month-end — over your {limit} budget.
insight.category_trend.<category>: {category} spending has been creeping up by about {growthRatePerMonth} per month.
insight.recurring.<category>: Recurring charge spotted: {description}, about {monthlyAmount} per month.
insight.savings_capacity: You have roughly {disposable} spare this month after recurring costs and budgets.
insight.budget_over_income: Your budgets total {committedBudgets} — {overBy} more than your declared income.
insight.budget_underspend.<category>: You typically spend {medianActual} of your {limit} {category} budget — it could be trimmed.
insight.subscription_price_hike.<categor: {description} charged {newAmount} this month, up from its usual {previousAmount}.
insight.project_off_track: At this pace, {projectName} will miss its deadline — it needs about {requiredMonthly} per month; you've been saving {observedMonthly}.
notification.suggestion.raise_budget: Your {arg} budget is on pace to overflow — raise it?
notification.suggestion.create_budget: Unusually high {arg} spending — set a budget for it?
notification.suggestion.set_category_lim: {arg} spending keeps climbing — set a first budget for it?

notification.suggestion.review_subscript: {arg} just charged more than usual — worth a quick review?
notification.suggestion.increase_contrib: {arg} is falling behind its deadline — put in a bit extra this month?
notification.suggestion.create_project: You have spare money this month — start a saving project for it?

notification.insight.duplicate_charge: Possible double-charge on {arg} — check your recent transactions.
notification.insight.income_drop: Last month's income came in well below your usual — worth a look.
notification.insight.cashflow_negative: Last month you spent more than you earned.
notification.insight.project_milestone: Nice one — {arg} just passed a savings milestone!
notification.insight.good_month: You stayed under every budget last month. Keep it up!
